item.title: Explained: Why WhatsApp is banned in Russia and what role the new MAX App plays in this
item.description: After banning WhatsApp and restricting other messaging apps, Russian authorities are promoting the state-backed MAX app as a national alternative. The platform offers messaging and government services but raises concerns over data sharing and encryption.
